# Steven Vanden Heuvel

> I make products feel considered, and I build the systems that keep them that way, usually before anyone asks. Product designer with design systems depth and a habit of building the tooling a design team needs, most recently on PayPal checkout. Based in Aurora, IL in the Chicago area, open to remote. This site is his portfolio: stevendesignco.com, published as Steven Design Co.

Steven worked on PayPal's Merchant Enablement team from December 2025 to August 2026 as a Principal Designer on contract. He designed merchant checkout proposals for the one-click program, more than twenty complete packages on weekly sprints for accounts including Home Depot, Target, and Nintendo, each one a screen audit, checkout flows, a working prototype, a prototype video, and a deck. On his own initiative he built a browser brief form and a Figma plugin that cut merchant flow setup from most of a day to 10 to 15 minutes across the 38-merchant program; it was adopted and in use when he handed it off. At a VP's request he mapped the checkout dead end customers hit when a saved payment method stops working, built the Figma board it was presented from with Claude Code, and the board became the team's template for mapping the next flows. He builds with Claude Code and Cursor every day.

Before PayPal he spent 18 years at MTG Media Group, growing from Senior Art Director to VP and Creative Director, and ran the responsive frameworks and design systems behind seven B2B publishing brands and six responsive sites. He brought responsive design, Pattern Lab and atomic design, Figma, and Storybook into a publishing company years before its peers had them. Plate, a complete new design he ran from content strategy workshop through Pattern Lab, Drupal theming, UserTesting.com, and launch, won the 2017 Jesse H. Neal Award for Best Website. He has four Jesse H. Neal Awards, six Neal finalist recognitions, and a Grand Neal finalist, top 4 nationally. He is looking for a Senior or Staff Product Designer seat where one person holds the whole flow, design systems are part of the job rather than the whole job, and tooling is wanted.

## Case studies

- [Work index](https://www.stevendesignco.com/work): Every case study and working artifact.
- [Merchant Flow Builder](https://www.stevendesignco.com/work/merchant-flow-builder): A browser brief form and Figma plugin, built on his own initiative, that assembles a merchant's full set of checkout flows.
- [PayPal: Becoming the Default at Checkout](https://www.stevendesignco.com/work/paypal): Merchant checkout proposals for the one-click program on weekly sprints, the three-library constraint, and the consumer-side checkout dead end.
- [Plate](https://www.stevendesignco.com/work/plate): A complete new design, workshop to launch. 2017 Jesse H. Neal Award for Best Website.
- [Meatingplace](https://www.stevendesignco.com/work/meatingplace): The flagship daily news site redesigned in Figma, ready to launch when the company was acquired.
- [Alt-Meat](https://www.stevendesignco.com/work/alt-meat): Brand identity, magazine, responsive site, and newsletters launched from nothing. 22,000 registered users.
- [Project Blackbird](https://www.stevendesignco.com/work/blackbird): An oral history microsite under the Plate brand. Grand Jesse H. Neal Finalist.
- [Design Systems](https://www.stevendesignco.com/design-systems): The practice behind the case studies: two Pattern Labs, two Storybook builds, and a Figma library of about 600 component variants, all browsable.
